fr.elements: Main Residence; Front Driveway; Access Drive; Vehicle Parking Area; Open Lawn Area; Dense Vegetation; Walkway
fr.considerations: Dense Vegetation; Vegetation Near Structure; Single Access Point; Limited Turnaround Space
fr.recommendations:
• Trim vegetation along both sides of the access drive so emergency vehicles can pass without obstruction.
• Cut back trees and shrubs that overhang the access drive to maintain vertical clearance for fire and rescue apparatus.
• Install a reflective marker or sign at the driveway entrance to help responders locate the property quickly from the road.
• Mark the property address visibly at the road entry point so it is readable from both directions of approach.
• Clear a turnaround area near the residence large enough for a fire engine or ambulance to reverse direction without backing the full length of the access drive.
• Keep the walkway to the front entrance clear of vegetation so responders can reach the door without obstruction.
• Thin dense vegetation near the structure so responders can move around the building on foot.
• Identify and communicate an alternate staging area on the open lawn where additional emergency vehicles can park without blocking the access drive.

wildfire.conditions: Structure Surrounded by Vegetation; Tree Cluster; Tree Cluster; Tree Cluster; Tree Cluster; Scattered Trees; Limited Vegetation Separation; Vegetation Near Structure; Long Driveway; Single Access Route; Ground Vegetation; Woody Debris
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim tree branches that hang directly over or touch the roof and walls of the structure.
• Thin the tree clusters surrounding the structure to create open gaps between individual trees.
• Remove shrubs and low-growing plants growing against or within a few feet of the structure's exterior walls.
• Clear dead leaves, needles, and woody debris from the roof, gutters, and ground immediately around the structure.
• Pick up and remove piles of woody debris, fallen branches, and dead plant material scattered around the property.
• Thin ground vegetation throughout the area between the tree clusters and the structure.
• Separate the lower branches of trees from the shrubs and ground vegetation growing beneath them by trimming branches up from the ground.
• Keep the full length of the driveway clear of overhanging branches low enough to obstruct a vehicle.
• Trim back vegetation along both sides of the driveway so a fire truck can pass through without obstruction.
• Mark the driveway entrance clearly so it is visible to emergency vehicles approaching from the road.
• Maintain a turnaround area or wide spot along the driveway where emergency vehicles can reverse direction.
• Remove any dead or dying trees standing near the structure or along the driveway.
